principles: The written script and approved spoken meaning are the content boundary.
Fast pacing never authorizes deleting correct words or unfinished word tails.
A-roll cuts require semantic, waveform, filmstrip and face-readiness evidence.
Captions are a complete one-to-one timed representation of approved speech.
B-roll proves the claim and never hides untrimmed silence or creates a short A-roll flash.
Motion and sound guide attention; they must not make a commercial video feel fragmented or aggressive.

gates.pass: the first delivery frame overlaps the first valid syllable, its visible mouth shape and a speaking-ready expression within 0.08 seconds; inhale and gesture preparation are absent
every take start is checked and all camera-direction speech is removed
recording-only completion comments such as done, finished or read complete are removed after the protected final word
all approved script words are present in audio and captions; no correct word is cut
caption starts and ends follow the matching voice region; silent ranges contain no caption
A-roll and B-roll use the same caption Y position and mobile safe width
adjacent B-roll connects directly; no sub-0.5-second A-roll flash appears between proof clips

spoken product-category lists use large sequential licensed or user-supplied image cards when suitable assets are available; each card matches the current spoken category and remains readable on a phone
normally 3-4 face-centered zooms; 8-9 frame attack, phrase hold, 8-9 frame release, at least 2 seconds after a transition
opening and semantic motion have moderate cues; nearby events share one cue; dialogue remains dominant
opening and adjacent spoken windows differ by no more than 1 dB after local leveling
skin is bright and neutral without dark-yellow cast; identity remains natural; before/after frames are reviewed
centered layout, face unobstructed, hook slightly above head, solid yellow strip with restrained red type
final MP4, clean A-roll, SRT, EDL, feedback and QA records are delivered and the final MP4 is fully decoded
